Dialogue_Text: Hello again, adventurer. Our Ink Gallery welcomes you with its tales.
We should talk downstairs. Unless you popped in only to see how I'm doing.
I hope you are having a fine day.
Hello, <CHARNAME>! You've seen all my books already—but perhaps you're here for one of the souvenirs?
So, from what I understood, by paying the fee I will be able to test myself in battles described in these books. Is that correct?
You said you came here from Cormyr, yes? Was it to open the Ink Gallery?
What happens if I successfully learn from all these books?
Don't you have any problems with the Cowled Wizards? Aren't these books magic?
I would like to buy some souvenirs.
I think I'll go now.
Yes. From what I understood, by paying the fee I will be able to test myself in battles described in these books. Is that correct?

Yes. The procedure is simple: approach the book, read its first page. Then, you may decide if you want to take the place of the book's main character. If you do, you'll need to pay the fee and you will get your chance to test your mettle in that battle. Win, learn from the battle, and return.
I understand.
That's good.
And if I die in the battle?
I fear it will be the same as if you died on the streets of Athkatla. However, our books come with better lessons; the rewards are quite satisfying.
Yes. You said you came here from Cormyr, yes? Was it to open the Ink Gallery?

Ah, I thought that you'd ask about the Gallery, but—yes. I am from Cormyr, but after my husband's death, I thought a change of scenery would be nice. I kept my title, I got quite used to being called a viscountess, but Athkatla's my new home.

My husband and I—we always believed that books can help people see the whole palette of colors of our reality, and while my husband is no longer with me, I've decided to keep the most precious of our books and take them with me here, to Amn. They became an asset and an inspiration behind opening the Ink Gallery.
This is why we can be here, talk about these books; this is also why adventurers, scholars, and daredevils may come here and test themselves: to learn, or to feel the thrills of excitement.
Yes. What happens if I successfully learn from all these books?
You'll prove you are a powerful <PRO_MANWOMAN>! Well, no one ever went through all these books before. Perhaps we should wonder about that once that happens.
Yes. Don't you have any problems with the Cowled Wizards? Aren't these books magic?
Well, I'm not casting any deadly spells on the streets! Besides, I have all the needed documents and permissions.
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
I suppose I would like to buy some souvenirs.
No. I think I'll go now.
Before I head downstairs, I would like to see all the souvenirs you still have available.
Mhm. I would like to see all the souvenirs you still have available.
Yes. I would like to see all the souvenirs you still have available.
Of course! Let me show you what I've got.
Let's go downstairs and continue our discussion there.
Whatever. I need to go.
I was just passing by, but I need to go now. Cheers!
